messages:
Taylor Nguyen: hi all, trying to finish onboarding. Okta enrollment errors out when I try to register MFA. Browser shows 'Unable to reach authenticator'. Anyone seen this?
Ivy (People Ops): welcome Taylor :wave: tagging @Noah from IT. Did you accept the Google Workspace invite and 1Password?
Taylor Nguyen: accepted Google and set up 1Password. Jamf invite shows delivered but i haven't enrolled device yet.
okta-bot: MFA enrollment may fail if device posture (MDM) is not met.
Noah (IT): @Taylor can you confirm OS + browser and whether you're behind a corp VPN? Also try disconnecting any USB hubs.
Taylor Nguyen: MacBook Air, macOS 14, Chrome latest. Home network, no VPN. I tried both Chrome and Safari.
Rina (Security): We recently moved new hires to WebAuthn-first enrollment. If Jamf hasn't marked the device managed, Okta may reject external TOTP flows. Did Jamf show pending?
Taylor Nguyen: yes, pending. I don't want to enroll my personal laptop. Is there a way to finish without MDM?
Derek (Hiring Manager): we can do a short-lived exception so you can start. Ivy, ok to request temporary bypass?
Ivy (People Ops): yes, we can request a 24-hour exception. Noah, can you open the exception and allow TOTP for Taylor?
Noah (IT): done. I enabled a 20-minute TOTP window on Taylor's account. Try re-enrolling now and use Authy or Google Authenticator.
Taylor Nguyen: trying...
(2 minutes)
Taylor Nguyen: success! Enrollment completed with TOTP. I can access Console and Slack but not all repos yet.
Noah (IT): adding you to #eng and #new-hires now. Also sent Jamf reminder; when you're ready you can enroll the company VM or we can schedule a swap.
Rina (Security): note: please enroll a company-managed device within 48 hours to keep full access. We'll revoke the exception after that.
Taylor Nguyen: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help. Noted on device enrollment.
